title: Signal's Meredith Whittaker says deeper integration of AI agents into devices is "perilous" for encryption, since agents need access to lots of data across apps (Shona Ghosh/Bloomberg)
summary: Shona Ghosh / Bloomberg: Signal's Meredith Whittaker says deeper integration of AI agents into devices is “perilous” for encryption, since agents need access to lots of data across apps — Artificial intelligence agents that autonomously carry out tasks pose a threat to secure apps such as Signal …
